description: Strict, executable hardware acceptance checklist for the ESP32-C3 Plane Radar. scripts/initialize-hardware-evidence.ps1 turns this into a pending hardware-results.json bound to the EXACT flashed default image SHA; scripts/verify-hardware-evidence.ps1 enforces it. Evidence is generated by a human operator on real hardware and lives under the ignored release package (never committed).

binding.note: Every gate binds to the flashed image SHA-256. The DEFAULT RELEASE gate flashes supermini/firmware-merged.bin. Item 6 measures memory/performance on the supermini-diag build of the SAME commit, but the default release image remains supermini. The WORKER PROMOTION gate is a SEPARATE gate on supermini-worker-diag and NEVER auto-promotes the worker to default.

status_values.blocked: could not be exercised (e.g. dense airspace unavailable) -- NOT a pass

default-release.title: DEFAULT RELEASE acceptance (image supermini/firmware-merged.bin)
default-release.note: All mandatory default-release items must be pass before the default supermini image ships.

worker-promotion.title: WORKER PROMOTION acceptance (image supermini-worker-diag/firmware-merged.bin)
worker-promotion.note: SEPARATE gate. Until EVERY worker item passes, the worker stays opt-in and supermini remains the default. This policy/script only REPORTS pass; it never auto-promotes.

items.title: Fresh flash + verify_flash of the default merged image, first boot to secured provisioning
procedure: Erase the chip: esptool.py --chip esp32c3 erase_flash
Flash the merged image at 0x0: esptool.py --chip esp32c3 --baud 921600 write_flash --flash_mode keep --flash_freq 80m --flash_size 4MB 0x0 supermini/firmware-merged.bin
Verify: esptool.py --chip esp32c3 verify_flash 0x0 supermini/firmware-merged.bin (must report a byte-exact match)
Power-cycle; capture serial at 115200; confirm first boot reaches the secured (WPA2, non-open) provisioning display

thresholds.rationale: esptool verify_flash of the exact merged image at offset 0x0 must byte-match
first boot must reach the secured provisioning screen (never an open AP)

evidence.name: flash/serial-first-boot.log
evidence.description: serial capture of the first boot reaching provisioning

items.title: WPA2 captive portal across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS
procedure: On EACH of Android, iOS, Windows, macOS: confirm the AP beacon is WPA2 (never open); a wrong password is rejected; a valid join opens the captive portal and a save succeeds
Confirm the 5-minute (300 s) session timeout is enforced
After completion confirm the AP, DNS (:53), and HTTP (:80) are all gone (no permanent listener)

thresholds.rationale: the first joinable beacon must already carry WPA2-PSK; never open/default
an incorrect PSK must be rejected on all four OSes
a valid join/portal/save must succeed on all four OSes
the setup session must self-terminate by 5 minutes
AP + DNS + HTTP must be fully torn down after provisioning

items.title: Normal-operation LAN scan: no open TCP ports, no UDP application listener
procedure: With the device in normal operation, run THREE full TCP sweeps: nmap -p 1-65535 -T4 -Pn <device-ip> (expect zero open)
Run a targeted UDP scan for portal/service ports: nmap -sU -p 53,80,123,443 -Pn <device-ip> (expect no application listener)

thresholds.rationale: three independent full 1-65535 TCP sweeps
no open TCP port during normal operation
no UDP application listener (SNTP is a client, not a server)

items.title: Packet capture: only approved egress, no normal-operation inbound listener
procedure: Capture >= 15 minutes of normal operation plus a reboot/time-sync and one provisioning session (Wi-Fi monitor sniffer or router mirror)
Confirm only local ARP/DHCP/DNS plus approved SNTP UDP/123 to time.cloudflare.com and HTTPS TCP/443 to opendata.adsb.fi
Confirm ZERO other fixed/public application destinations and NO normal-operation inbound listener
Document that DNS/DHCP servers are network-provider dependent and may vary

thresholds.rationale: at least 15 minutes of normal operation captured
no fixed/public application destination beyond opendata.adsb.fi and time.cloudflare.com
no inbound listener during normal (non-provisioning) operation
SNTP UDP/123 goes only to time.cloudflare.com
HTTPS TCP/443 goes only to opendata.adsb.fi

items.title: Real SNTP trusted time then verified adsb.fi TLS, no insecure fallback
procedure: Observe that trusted UTC time is established (SNTP) BEFORE the first HTTPS fetch
Observe a successful ADS-B data fetch over verified TLS to opendata.adsb.fi
Confirm there is no insecure fallback (no setInsecure path) and observe certificate chain/date behaviour
This is a RUNTIME proof; the offline CA/egress source gates are necessary but not sufficient

thresholds.rationale: TLS must not proceed before trusted time
a real verified-TLS ADS-B fetch must succeed
no insecure TLS fallback is permitted
the peer certificate chain/date must validate against the pinned roots

evidence.name: sntp-tls/serial-time-then-fetch.log
evidence.description: serial log: trusted time then first fetch

items.title: Diagnostic memory/performance acceptance (measured on supermini-diag of the SAME commit)
procedure: Flash supermini-diag/firmware-merged.bin (SAME commit) purely to MEASURE; the released default remains supermini
Run a representative load with the sprite path (sprite=1) throughout; collect the diag: fetch_ms / render_us lines
Record minimum free heap, minimum largest-free-block, render p95/max, and any resets/panics

thresholds.rationale: Conservative floor. The ESP32-C3 has ~400 KB SRAM but the single 240x240 RGB565 sprite framebuffer (115200 B) plus the WiFiClientSecure TLS working set consume a large share; >=40 KB free leaves clear headroom for a TLS record + JSON decode frame.
Fragmentation floor: a single TLS record buffer (~16 KB) must remain allocatable; 20 KB is a conservative largest-free-block floor.
One framebuffer pushed once per frame over 40 MHz SPI has a ~23 ms transfer floor (115200 B x 8 / 40e6); 150 ms p95 leaves generous drawing headroom while catching runaway redraws.
Worst-case single frame bound (includes runway overlay compositing); 250 ms catches pathological frames without asserting an unmeasured tight bound.
measurement must be taken with the double-buffered sprite path (sprite=1) that the release uses
no resets or panics during the representative load

evidence.name: diag/serial-diag-load.log
evidence.description: serial diag: lines over the representative load

evidence.name: diag/heap-summary.txt
evidence.description: min free heap + min largest-free-block summary

items.title: Dense-airspace nearest-64 bounded behaviour
procedure: Exercise the device against real airspace with enough successful responses to observe > 64 source aircraft if available
Confirm nearest-64 bounded behaviour, no crash, and correct stale expiry
If > 64 source aircraft cannot be observed, mark this item BLOCKED (not pass)

thresholds.rationale: must exercise the > 64 nearest-64 bound (else mark blocked)
only the nearest 64 are retained/rendered
no crash under dense load
stale targets expire correctly under churn

items.title: Default 48-hour soak
procedure: Run the default image for >= 48 hours of continuous operation
Confirm zero watchdog/panic/brownout resets and no unexpected reboot
Confirm bounded heap drift and Wi-Fi/API recovery after a controlled outage
Confirm data goes stale by 15 s and targets are hidden/offline by 60 s

thresholds.rationale: 48-hour continuous soak
no watchdog/panic/brownout resets
no unexpected reboot
bounded heap drift over 48 h (leak detection); 20 KB is a conservative drift ceiling for a device with no dynamic runway cache and a single framebuffer
Wi-Fi/API recovers after a controlled outage
Live->Stale at the configured 15 s threshold
targets hidden/offline at the configured 60 s threshold

items.title: WORKER PROMOTION: 72-hour supermini-worker-diag concurrency soak
procedure: SEPARATE gate. Flash supermini-worker-diag/firmware-merged.bin and run >= 72 hours
Record worker task stack high-water FREE bytes (of the 8192-byte stack)
Record min free heap and min largest-free-block during concurrent fetch + display/button/portal work
Force DNS/TLS stalls and confirm portal/button remain responsive; confirm no deadlock/race/reset
Passing this gate REPORTS worker readiness only; it never auto-promotes the worker to default

thresholds.rationale: 72-hour worker concurrency soak
conservative >= 2048 B free of the 8192 B worker stack (>= 25% margin)
same conservative heap floor as the default diagnostic gate, under worker concurrency
TLS-record-sized largest-free-block floor under worker concurrency
UI/portal/button stay responsive during forced DNS/TLS stalls
no deadlock/race/reset across 72 h

items.title: Real GC9A01 display integrity
procedure: On a real GC9A01 240x240 panel confirm correct black/green/white/red/yellow/cyan/magenta/blue, inversion/BGR channel order, cardinal orientation, text/round-edge clipping, and brightness
Confirm 40 MHz SPI stability across >= 1000 full refreshes with no corruption

thresholds.rationale: >= 1000 full refreshes exercised
no visual corruption at 40 MHz SPI
the configured 40 MHz SPI clock
BGR/inversion decoded colours match on the real panel (goldens do NOT prove colour)
cardinal orientation correct on the real panel

evidence.name: display/colors.jpg
evidence.description: colour swatches on the real panel

items.title: Button boundaries and bounce (actual timing policy)
procedure: Using the actual policy, verify: < 40 ms ignored; 40-999 ms Tap; 1000-1999 ms dead band; 2000-7999 ms Configure on release; >= 8000 ms only ARMS (same hold never erases)
Verify the confirm second press must START within 10000 ms of release and be held >= 3000 ms to erase
Run repeated trials near every boundary; confirm NO false erase

thresholds.rationale: repeated trials near each boundary
a single continuous hold (or any near-boundary trial) must never erase
tap_min_ms boundary
arm_ms boundary
confirm_window_ms
confirm_hold_ms

items.title: Power / brownout resilience (fail-closed)
procedure: Record supply/3V3 under Wi-Fi/TLS/display load (label the measurement setup and probe assumptions)
Perform controlled power interruptions DURING a credential commit and DURING an erase transaction
Confirm correct fail-closed recovery-marker behaviour on the next boot and NO false success

thresholds.rationale: Conservative floor. 3V3 nominal is 3300 mV; the ESP32-C3 brownout detector trips around 2.43-3.0 V. Requiring the measured minimum under load to stay >= 3000 mV flags a marginal supply. LABEL the probe point and measurement bandwidth (a scope min, not a multimeter average).
enough interruption trials across commit and erase transactions to exercise the durable marker
a power loss mid-transaction must never be reported as a successful commit/erase
the NVS transaction marker must recover fail-closed on the next boot

evidence.name: power/3v3-under-load.csv
evidence.description: 3V3 minimum under Wi-Fi/TLS/display load (with probe notes)
